derivation: Contributed by Justin D. Kintzele (J Diesel NY / ECR-WG) from the IICP monotonic-trace example. The native parent grant (10 kW, 7200 s, circuit groups 1-3, 10.0.0.0/16, 08:00-18:00) is narrowed to ups-unit-01 (2.5 kW, 900 s, group 2, 10.0.1.0/24, 14:00-15:00). CLC Core v1 does not evaluate network or wall-clock windows statically, so the projected child grant authorizes the delegated operation with two residual obligations and the verdict is allow_unresolved (§8.4). execution_checks lists the runtime boundary checks the profile leaves to the carrier; they are not carrier policy dimensions and are not projected into a CLC field.
